title: Think-tank conference on crash retrievals by Russia, China and the US

tellings.quote: let's assume that there have been crash revals by Russia China and the United States

plain: A think-tank meeting in Washington supposedly started from the assumption that Russia, China and the United States have each carried out crash retrievals, meaning they recovered crashed craft of unknown origin. Michels tells it as something he heard from the physicist Hal Puthoff, quoting the premise as "let's assume that there have been crash retrievals by Russia, China and the United States." If true, it would mean serious policy people treat such recoveries as a working fact.
